emails.subject: Atlas Console exports failing since the 04:00 job

thread.body: Priya - our nightly Atlas export produced a zero-byte file again last night. That is the second time this week. Our warehouse planning run depends on it landing before 06:00. Can someone look?

Thanks for flagging, Tomas. I've escalated to our platform team tonight. I'll send you a written status update by 5pm tomorrow, and if we can't identify the cause by then I'll set up a call with the engineer who owns the export pipeline.

It failed again this morning, so that's three nights. We are now hand-keying the planning inputs, which we cannot sustain past today. I'd like the status update you promised, and I'd also like to know whether we should switch back to the legacy export format in the meantime.

emails.subject: Renewal paperwork for the Loomstack data feed

thread.body: Hi Priya, our data feed agreement with Harborline comes up for renewal at the end of next quarter. Before I send the paperwork over, could you confirm two things: (1) whether you want to stay on the 500k-row daily tier or move up to 2M rows, and (2) who should be named as the technical contact now that Ravi has moved teams? No rush, but it helps me get the draft right the first time.

Pipeline atlas-console/main build #4821 failed at stage integration-tests. Failing test: test_export_schema_roundtrip. Duration 6m12s. Commit 8f2ad19 by r.anand. This is an automated message. Do not reply to this message.

emails.subject: Re: Review request - permissions migration runbook

thread.body: Priya, I've drafted the rollback runbook for the permissions migration. It's in the shared docs folder. Would you take a pass on the escalation section? I'm not confident I've captured what support actually needs at 2am.
Happy to. I will review the escalation section and leave comments by Wednesday. If I think it needs restructuring rather than edits, I'll say so rather than rewriting it myself.

Gentle nudge on this one - no pressure at all, I just want to know whether to hold the doc or start circulating it to the support leads. If you'd rather I go ahead and share the current version, that's fine too.

emails.subject: Speaker submissions close tomorrow - Harborline slot

thread.body: Hi Priya, following up because the submission deadline for the platform track is tomorrow at 23:59 and I have not seen an abstract from Harborline yet. You mentioned in January that you wanted to talk about running a schema migration without downtime. If you can send me a title and a three-line abstract I can lodge it for you, but I need it before the deadline - after that the track is locked.
